Workflows we build

What changes, workflow by workflow.

  • Commercial loan intake and document portal

    nCino · Baker Hill · your document imaging system
    Today
    Checklists live in a spreadsheet and documents arrive as email attachments.
    What we build
    Each borrower gets one secure link to a live checklist. They upload documents and complete the personal financial statement and debt schedule online. The banker accepts or returns each item and sends reminders listing exactly what is outstanding.

  • Financial spreading and credit memo assembly

    Your spreading template · nCino · Baker Hill
    Today
    Tax returns are keyed by hand, then the memo is assembled from scratch.
    What we build
    Returns and statements are extracted into your spreading template with each line linked to its source page. A memo draft is generated in your format from the approved spread. The analyst reviews, corrects and owns the result.

  • KYC, AML and BSA document collection

    Core customer records · Salesforce Financial Services Cloud
    Today
    Beneficial ownership certifications and identification are collected ad hoc and filed inconsistently.
    What we build
    A guided collection flow for entity documents, beneficial ownership and identification, time-stamped at every step, with a per-customer evidence file you can export for an examiner.

  • Treasury management onboarding

    Core and treasury platforms · e-signature
    Today
    Service setup forms, signer authority and entitlements are gathered on paper and re-typed.
    What we build
    One online onboarding package per client: services, accounts, signers and user entitlements collected once, routed for approval, and handed to operations in the format they key from.

  • Covenant and tickler tracking

    Loan system extracts · your tickler process
    Today
    Reporting requirements are tracked in calendars and spreadsheets.
    What we build
    Covenants and reporting requirements tracked per loan, borrower reminders sent automatically, and exceptions surfaced to the relationship manager before they age.
How it works

Extraction you can check, with a person in the loop.

Every value carries its source. Anything that does not reconcile is held for review.

  1. Documents inUploads, email attachments, system exports.
  2. ExtractFields pulled into a fixed structure, with the source page recorded.
  3. ReviewValidation rules run. A person confirms or corrects what is flagged.
  4. System of recordApproved data lands in your model, CRM, core or fund-admin system.
  5. ReportMemos, statements and audit trails generated from approved data.

Security

How your data is handled.

Security and data handling

  • Borrower and customer data stays in your systems. We do not keep a copy of customer PII on MonkFlow infrastructure.

  • Deployment inside your own cloud environment is available, so data never leaves your perimeter.

  • AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS in transit, role-based access for lenders, credit and operations, and an event log of every upload, download and decision.

  • We complete your vendor due-diligence questionnaire and walk your information security team through the architecture before any data moves.

Questions

What firms ask us first.

Do you replace our core or loan origination system?

No. We build the layer around them: the borrower-facing portal, the extraction and review step, and the integration that puts approved data where it belongs.

Where does borrower data live?

In your systems. What we build can be deployed inside your own cloud environment. Files are encrypted at rest with AES-256, and we do not keep a copy of customer PII on MonkFlow infrastructure.

How is AI used in credit work?

For reading and drafting only: pulling figures out of returns and statements, and producing a first draft of a memo in your format. Calculations are deterministic, every figure links to its source page, and a credit analyst reviews and approves the result. Models can run in your own cloud or under zero-retention configurations.

Have you worked with banks before?

Our named client work so far is in wealth management, with Team Financial Strategies. For banking we have built a working commercial loan document portal with encrypted uploads, online financial forms and a banker dashboard, which you can try today.

What does an engagement cost?

It depends on the workflow, the systems involved and your deployment requirements. Every engagement is scoped individually, and you see a written scope and quote before any build work starts.

Not sure where to start? Start with a workflow audit.

We map one workflow and the systems around it, rank the automation opportunities, and write up scope and data handling. You decide what, if anything, to build.

Bring us your worst manual workflow.

A working session is 20 minutes with the engineer who would build it. Walk through the process, and leave with a straight answer on whether it is worth automating.
